tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog skyong la bka' bsgo gnang ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ chos skyong ba rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs las nye bar bskrun pa'i khye'u de'i ming*/ dharma pha la rak+ṣi ta zhes bya bar btags pa yin/ 'di la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ mkhyen brtse ldan pa'i mkhyen brtse'i byin rlabs dang*// mthu stobs mchog gis mthu stobs nus mthu dang*// lhag bsam dag pas lhag bsam byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar gsol ba de ltar 'grub gyur cig /sa mo lug gi lo ston zla rwa ba'i tshes bdun gyi snga dro'i cha la/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog skyong gi gur chen du bris pa'o// //phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig /e dharma he tu pra bha bā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
